filters.predicate: kind_id == tv_kind_id AND production_year BETWEEN 2005 AND 2008

filters.evaluate: scan per t2_id offsets range; bytewise memcmp vs "3.0"

join_order.notes: Iterate lt_ids; for each lt_id, walk [off[lt_id], off[lt_id+1]) into rowids array to get ml row r. Yields ~5000 ml rows out of 29997.
Direct array deref title.kind_id[t1_id-1], title.kind_id[t2_id-1], title.production_year[t2_id-1]. Early-reject on kt and year filters.

join_order.probe: t1_id -> mi_idx1 rows; t2_id -> mi_idx2 rows
join_order.notes: For mi_idx1: walk offsets[t1_id..t1_id+1], filter info_type_id==rating_id, capture info MIN. For mi_idx2: same range walk on t2_id, also require lex(info)<'3.0'. Skip ml row if either side has no qualifying mi_idx row.

join_order.probe: t1_id -> mc1 rows (cn1_us_bitset filter); t2_id -> mc2 rows (no country filter)
join_order.notes: For mc1: walk offsets[t1_id..t1_id+1], require cn1_us_bitset[company_id-1], capture company_name.name[company_id-1] for MIN. For mc2: walk offsets[t2_id..t2_id+1], no filter, capture name. Skip ml row if either side empty.
After all 4 sub-probes succeed for an ml row, update min for cn1.name, cn2.name, mi_idx1.info, mi_idx2.info, t1.title, t2.title.

data_structures.mins: 6 thread-local MinAccumulator<string_view>, lex compare, merged at end

parallelism.morsel: after expanding lt_ids→ml rowids (~5000 rows), partition rowids into ~256 morsels across 12 threads
parallelism.notes: Each thread maintains 6 thread-local MIN accumulators; final merge with lex-min reduction. All deref structures are read-only mmapped binaries.

indexes.purpose: per-movie company lookup (both t1 and t2 sides)
per-movie rating lookup (both t1 and t2 sides)

string_compare.mi_idx2_info_lt_3_0: bytewise memcmp(slice.ptr, "3.0", min(slice.len,3)); on tie use length: shorter < longer; matches numeric intent on values like "1.7","2.8","3.1"
